The turtle's head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small eyes. The carapace is high-domed, dark brown/black, and appears smooth/glossy. The limbs are partially visible, appearing stout. There is a strip of gibberish text/watermark at the very bottom edge of the image.

While individual claws are hard to resolve due to shadow/mud, the general morphology fits the 'stout' description.
